changes.realtime_weather: Already implemented, including periodic refresh: fetchWeather() runs at startup and again every 15 minutes via setInterval. This was already present before this session; verified it's genuinely in place rather than changed.
changes.crop_position_finetune: No new specific direction was given this round beyond the general already-addressed goal, so no further coordinate change was made without more specific feedback.

harvest_button_bug.root_cause_hypothesis: Could not reproduce the exact sequence directly, but found the specific failure mode that would cause it: if growMs or plantedAt ever became invalid (NaN, zero, corrupted), the old 'elapsed < growMs' comparison against NaN is always false in JavaScript, so the still-growing check would never block harvesting -- matching 'harvest available right after planting'.
harvest_button_bug.fix: Added a shared plotGrowth(i) helper used consistently by openFarm(), usePlot(), harvestPlot(), and drawCrops(). It validates growMs/plantedAt are sane; if not, treats the plot as not ready and auto-repairs by resetting plantedAt to now.
harvest_button_bug.verified: Injected a deliberately corrupted plot and confirmed it was auto-repaired to a valid state on the next render instead of being immediately harvestable.

road_traffic_hazard.what_was_built: Cars occasionally spawn on random road segments (checked every 8s, 30% chance, capped at 2 concurrent) and travel the road graph, turning at junctions, despawning after a few hops. Car speed uses the same pixel-equalized worldStep helper as player movement.
road_traffic_hazard.collision: Player within 2.2 world-units of a car ends the game immediately with a game-over screen; its close button is hidden so only the restart button can dismiss it.
road_traffic_hazard.restart_behavior: Restart reloads the page without touching localStorage, so gold/inventory/farm/upgrades all survive -- only play position resets. Flagging this interpretation explicitly in case a full save wipe was actually intended instead.

verification.syntax: node --check passes on game.js and game-systems.js.
verification.harvest_fix_tested: Confirmed corrupted-plot auto-repair via direct localStorage injection.
verification.car_collision_tested: Reproduced the collision -> game-over screen naturally during live play across two separate test runs.
verification.restart_gold_preservation_tested: Confirmed gold set before the game loads survives a collision + restart cycle.
verification.existing_regression_suite_rerun: JS syntax check, road-graph integrity, the stuck-at-node escape test, the speed-equalization test, and the standard headless-browser playthrough all still pass.
